help.fullAddress: Office-207, 2nd Floor, A J Chamber, Gali No. 4, Pyare Lal Road, Karol Bagh, New Delhi – 110005, India
help.faq1Question: How do I download my 80G tax receipt?
help.faq1Answer: All tax-exempt receipts are automatically emailed to your registered email address within 24 hours of donation. You can also view and download them directly from your Profile > Contribution History section.
help.faq2Question: Can I cancel or change my membership plan?
help.faq2Answer: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or pause your membership anytime. Go to the Membership Tab in the drawer or send us a request here, and our support team will handle it within 24 hours.
help.faq3Question: What are the visiting hours for the Gaushala?
help.faq3Answer: We are open to visitors every day from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Special guided tours and cow feeding sessions take place between 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM and 4:00 PM - 5:30 PM.
help.faq4Question: How do I sponsor feed for a specific cow?
help.faq4Answer: You can select "Sponsor a Cow" from the home screen quick actions (feature coming soon) or submit a request in the contact form below with the name of the cow you wish to support.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.intro: Gau Mata Sewa Trust ("we", "us", or "our") operates the Gaumata Trust mobile application. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use the application.
privacy.section1Content: The trust collects personal information, including names, contact details, and profile information, to maintain user records and facilitate communication.
privacy.section2Content: Information is used solely for the purpose for which it was provided, such as providing our services, sending updates, and informing users about NGO activities.
privacy.section3Content: The trust states that it does not sell, trade, or rent personal information to third parties. Information may only be shared with trusted partners and service providers for specific tasks like service delivery.
privacy.section4Content: Reasonable security measures are employed to protect personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
privacy.section5Content: Users can opt out of receiving communications by following instructions in emails or by contacting the NGO directly. The trust reserves the right to modify its privacy policy, and continued use of their services implies acceptance of any updated terms.
privacy.section6Content: If you have any questions or complaints about this Privacy Policy, please contact our support cell at:

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these Terms & Conditions ("Terms") carefully before using the Gaumata Trust mobile application. By accessing or using our services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms.
terms.section1Content: By accessing or using the services of the Gaumata Sewa Trust, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms.section2Content: Content is for general informational purposes only. The NGO reserves the right to modify or update information at any time without prior notice.
terms.section3Content: Participation in the trust's activities and community programs is voluntary. Members are expected to engage respectfully and contribute to the welfare of cows in whatever way they can.
terms.refundContent: The application currently does not process any financial transactions or online payments. Any donations or contributions must be made directly to the trust through official channels.
terms.section4Content: All content, including text, images, logos, and graphics, is the property of the NGO and is protected by copyright laws.
terms.section5Content: Users are expected to interact respectfully and refrain from activities that could harm the NGO or its reputation. The NGO is not responsible for the content or privacy practices of any external websites linked on their platform. The trust reserves the right to update or modify these terms at any time.
terms.section6Content: For questions regarding these Terms, please reach out to us at:
